_readme: S405 SkyCholla, 2026-10-17. Ohlone's registry names www.ohlone.edu/catalog; the generic capture (run on claude/s405-ohlone) found 1 of 179 programs: its program pages (ohlone.edu/program/<slug>) name none of their listed course codes. This read lists the catalog page's links and one program page's links, so a session can tell where the catalog prints each program's requirements (a catalog host, a PDF, or a requirements tab). Two loads, no model call.

questions.catalog_address: Where the 2026-2027 catalog prints each program's courses and units: its host, PDF or page form.
